verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official MCP server (mcp.md, mcp-servers.md) exposing AvaTax capabilities like tax calculation, transaction retrieval, nexus lookup, and AI-powered tax code recommendations as tools an agent can call. This is first-party documentation but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world agent connections. Missing for 10: independent verification of MCP server usage in practice, details on authentication/setup friction for agents.
